notes.title: Chat with the devs
notes.notes:
As part of the Steam Game Festival we will be chatting about worms, their anatomy and habits. Also will share development plans, spoiler levels from future releases, discuss ideas and suggestions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27817245/1904cf3b69c9c481ade23f3c3839eaa8cf08b14e.jpg[/img]

[h3]About the game:[/h3]

Insatia is a carnivorous worm simulator with an innovative control system and a charming atmosphere full of creepy crawly cannibalism. Odd insects huddle in a corner, worms rip each other apart, and people push buttons and laugh.

Key features:
[list]
[*] A tactical combat system, allowing worms to tear each other to pieces.
[*] Elements of the 'Eat or Run' genre: everything in the game is growing, eating or being eaten.
[*] A control system imitating the movement of reptiles: worms must wriggle to move!
[/list]

notes.title: Live stream event!
notes.notes:
As part of the Steam Game Festival we will be streaming Insatia.
We will try to play through all 15 levels of the demo, while getting all the achievements.
Food is cunning, creeping, and is not going to eat itself alone! Come see how hard it is for the developer to beat their own game. :)

notes.title: Insatia
notes.notes:
Insatia is a carnivorous worm simulator with an innovative control system and a charming atmosphere full of creepy crawly cannibalism. Odd insects huddle in a corner, worms rip each other apart, and people push buttons and laugh.

[previewyoutube=MvEG0jFJr9o;full][/previewyoutube]

Key features:
[list]
[*] A tactical combat system, allowing worms to tear each other to pieces.
[*] Elements of the 'Eat or Run' genre: everything in the game is growing, eating or being eaten.
[*] A control system imitating the movement of reptiles: worms must wriggle to move!
[/list]

The demo contains 15 out of 45 levels of the singleplayer campaign, plus a few splitscreen levels for playing with friends. Thanks to the Steam Play Together feature you don't even need to sit behind the same PC. It won't be extra easy, the controls require some getting used to, but it will award you with a lot of novel experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27817245/8fb24ecffd1b508d9aa7bf11c0002aadabae305e.png[/img]


If you defeated the slush boss in the demo, it is not the end yet! There is one more secret 15th level, which has no goal, but features laser cutter and an opportunity to control the acid worm. Laser cutter and acid worm - what could possibly go wrong!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27817245/70d0b2dce50ca6ff14cb2ce096c0ffe60842220f.png[/img]

notes.title: Pufferball
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27817245/f7eae8f06f57faf2e27ff4e3c44af61fa0e855fb.png[/img]

Pufferball is a 3 vs 3 game. Score a goal by bringing the puffer to the opposing team's goal area (and try not to swallow it in the process). After scoring a goal the puffer is either eaten by carrying player or grilled by referee turret. Biting, pushing, ripping apart the opposing team is allowed. New worm is given to a player immediately should they lost one. Ready? Go!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MKxZoU4oHDA
